record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, jointly lower learning rate from 1e-3 to 5e-4 and dropout from 0.3 to 0.2. Smaller updates may stabilize pairwise optimization, while reduced dropout preserves more signal in predominantly short histories and offsets slower fitting. Retain width 64, two blocks, two heads, batch size 128, maxlen 128, AdamW and existing weight decay. Keep features, parameterization, interaction/readout formulas and loss unchanged; retain seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.2. Smaller updates may stabilize pairwise optimization, while reduced dropout preserves short-history signal and offsets slower fitting. Retain all other hyperparameters, features, HSTU computations, readout and loss. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible; inference disables dropout.
